name: Kentucky Christian University
academic_ranking: Private, 4-year, non-profit Christian university affiliated with the Christian Churches and Churches of Christ, located in Grayson, KY. Carnegie classification: Baccalaureate Colleges - Diverse Fields. Small enrollment of about 550 students (494 undergraduate) with a 12-to-1 student-to-faculty ratio. Overall (IPEDS) graduation rate of 37%. (Source: NCES College Navigator, id=157100)
financial_aid: NCES-reported tuition and fees for 2024-2025 total $26,625. KCU emphasizes affordability of private Christian higher education. Per KCU cost-of-attendance page: average institutional gift assistance of $12,841 per student and an average total financial aid package of $24,913. Eligible students may receive Pell Grants and federal Direct Loans. (Sources: NCES College Navigator; kcu.edu/apply-afford/cost-aid/cost-of-attendance)
facilities_notes: Campus at 100 Academic Parkway, Grayson, KY 41143, with on-campus housing available. Softball competes as the KCU Knights in the NAIA Appalachian Athletic Conference. No specific softball facility details (stadium/field name) were publicly listed on the softball program pages checked 2026-07.
program_reputation: NAIA women's softball program competing in the Appalachian Athletic Conference (AAC). Team social handle @GoKnightsSB. No notable national ranking or postseason accolades were confirmed on the pages checked; treat reputation as unverified beyond AAC membership.
notes: Researched live 2026-07 from kcuknights.com. Softball URL code is 'sball'. Coaching staff captured from https://kcuknights.com/sports/sball/coaches/index and individual bio pages. Roster size (19) counted from 2025-26 roster page https://kcuknights.com/sports/sball/2025-26/roster. Only the head coach lists an individual email and phone; assistants/coordinator/student assistant show only the shared university switchboard (606-474-3270), so their individual email/phone were left blank. No individual Twitter/X handles are listed for coaches (team account is @GoKnightsSB). Tuition/academic/financial-aid data corroborated via NCES College Navigator (id=157100) and kcu.edu.
